gre_general.value: GRE requirement is waived for all engineering applicants for Fall 2027.
gre_general.quote: *The UGA College of Engineering has waived the GRE requirement for all applicants for Fall 2026, Spring 2027, and Fall 2027.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Biomedical Engineering subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty members whose research aligns with their interests regarding Research Assistantship opportunities.
supervisor.quote: We strongly encourage applicants to review our online faculty directory and browse our faculty expertise directory, then contact those faculty members whose research aligns with their interests. Applicants should ask faculty directly about Research Assistantship opportunities that may be available.

funding.value: All applicants are considered for Research Assistantships, which provide tuition waiver and stipend.
funding.quote: All applicants are considered for Research Assistantships, which provide a tuition waiver and a stipend.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from four-year bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: A four-year bachelor’s degree, a three-year bachelor’s plus a master’s degree, or a three-year bachelor’s plus completion of first year of the master’s program from a recognized institution by the Association of Indian University (AIU) or All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).
